title: Oman meeting between Gulf states and Iran delayed — Reuters
summary: Omani Foreign Minister Badr Albusaidi said that a meeting in Oman between ‌Gulf countries and Iran to discuss possible agreements on the Strait of Hormuz, which had been scheduled for Monday, ‌has been postponed, Reuters reported on Sunday.
